links.outcome: Calibration of DRAT-up before and after local recalibration in older Chinese adults
links.effect: Original DRAT-up underestimated risk in older Chinese adults; recalibrating it improved calibration.
links.quote: The original DRAT-up model underestimated the risk of developing depressive symptoms in older Chinese adults; recalibrating it improved calibration.

links.outcome: Performance of European-developed model when applied to a new population (older Chinese adults)
